messages:
anna_support: Customer ACME escalated — embeddings dashboard shows ~3.6k units but their API reports ~1.2k vectors. Customer says billing matches API. Opening thread to triage.

ryan_sre: Can you paste a sample request_id + time window and a screenshot? Also did they use batching or a replay?

anna_support: req_id: req_0b12345, window: 2025-10-12 14:00-15:00 UTC. Payload indicated batch_size=3, model=rw-embed-large, input_tokens=512. Screenshot uploaded: https://redwood.app/s/ACME/snap.png. Customer says numbers diverge only for embeddings chart (units column).

leo_analytics: Quick look at the metrics rollup — our charting query currently sums vector_count and token_units and exposes a single "units" column. If both event types exist for the same request we end up double-counting. Running a small repro query now.

leo_analytics: ```sql
SELECT
  count(distinct request_id) as requests,
  sum(vector_count) as vectors,
  sum(token_units) as tokens,
  sum(vector_count + token_units) as units_sum
FROM embed_events
WHERE request_time BETWEEN '2025-10-12 14:00:00' AND '2025-10-12 15:00:00'
  AND customer_id = 'acme'
  AND request_id = 'req_0b12345';
```

maria_eng: This matches a known edge: when batch_size>1 we emit both per-item vector events and an aggregate token_units event for the batch (legacy pipeline + new caching replay). The dashboard sum treats them as independent and sums both. Root cause = event-model mismatch + missing unit_type tag in older events.

maria_eng: Short term: UI can filter to unit_type=vector (or tokens) so numbers line up with API. Mid-term: metrics-service should dedupe by event_id or attach a unit_type on ingestion. I'll prepare a patch.

ryan_sre: Actionables: 1) anna, send customer this filtered view link showing unit_type=vector. 2) maria, please open PR to dedupe by event_id and add unit_type tag. 3) analytics: add a defensive guard in charting to not sum both vector_count + token_units when they share the same request_id.

anna_support: Sent filtered view to customer — they confirmed counts now match API when viewed as vectors. They want ETA for permanent fix and an explanation for billing team.

maria_eng: I'll prioritize a fix today — plan: add unit_type to ingestion (+ backfill for last 7 days), update rollup to prefer vector_count when present, and add dedupe by event_id. ETA ~4h for PR + runbook, ~24h for staging rollout and backfill. Will post PR link when ready.

ryan_sre: Good. I'll schedule a quick postmortem note and flag billing team so they don't action on the inflated dashboard numbers. :thumbsup:
